technical-summary: Evidence for a scratch native-fold variant of the gfx11 IQ8R GEMM row: byte-identical outputs on 17 shapes, +1.8% geomean over 40 large shapes but only +0.12%/+0.32% on the LTX video FFN up/down; not shipped. Tile, K-unroll and weight-staging variants remain untried.
user-summary-candidate: Measured one gfx1100 IQ8R int8 kernel variant: byte-identical but under 0.4% faster on the dominant LTX FFN; not shipped.
